about: Vectors for the YAML subset a routine.yaml may use (python: bollardeck.routines.yamlsubset.loads). "text" is the file's text. A vector with "value" must be read as exactly that value; every such text reads the same in a full YAML 1.1 or 1.2 reader. A text that starts with { is one JSON object (the specification allows a manifest in JSON). A vector with "error": true must be refused, and "line" is the 1-based line an implementation should name. Every text is made up.

vectors.name: typical-manifest
vectors.about: 0.1.0 has two dots, so it is a string in every YAML reader.
vectors.text:
# a comment
name: demo_routine
version: 0.1.0
author: Example Hacker
api: 1
hooks: [on_plan, on_verdict]
limits:
  max_ms_per_call: 20
  max_notes_factor: 1.5

vectors.name: folded-scalar
vectors.text:
description: >
  Two lines that
  become one.

  And a second paragraph.
name: x1

value.description:
Two lines that become one.
And a second paragraph.
value.name: x1

vectors.name: literal-scalar
vectors.text:
notes: |
  line one
    kept indent

  line four

value.notes:
line one
  kept indent

line four

vectors.name: quoted-strings
vectors.text:
a: "0.1"
b: '1'
c: "say \"hi\"\n"
d: 'it''s'
e: "# not a comment"
f: 'yes'

vectors.name: booleans-and-nulls
vectors.text:
a: true
b: False
c: null
d: ~
e:
f: TRUE

vectors.name: plain-strings
vectors.text:
a: Example Hacker
b: 1.2.3
c: v2
d: a-b_c.d
e: it's fine
f: http://example.test/x
g: -dash

vectors.name: comments
vectors.about: A # only starts a comment at the start of a line or after a space.
vectors.text:
# top
a: 1   # after a value

   # indented comment
b: x#y
c: [p, q]  # after a flow list

vectors.name: tab-indent
vectors.about: Tabs are not indentation.

vectors.name: anchor
vectors.about: Anchors are outside the subset.

vectors.name: alias
vectors.about: Aliases are outside the subset.

vectors.name: tag
vectors.about: Tags are outside the subset.

vectors.name: merge-key
vectors.about: Merge keys are outside the subset.

vectors.name: duplicate-key
vectors.about: A key may appear once. A full reader would silently keep the last.

vectors.name: mapping-in-a-list
vectors.about: A list holds scalars only.

vectors.name: nested-flow
vectors.about: No collection inside a flow collection.

vectors.name: flow-over-two-lines
vectors.about: A flow collection closes on its line.

vectors.name: multi-line-plain-scalar
vectors.about: A plain value does not run over a line.

vectors.name: second-document
vectors.about: One document.

vectors.name: quoted-key
vectors.about: Keys are plain words.

vectors.name: top-level-scalar
vectors.about: A document is a mapping or a list.

vectors.name: yes-is-ambiguous
vectors.about: YAML 1.1 reads a boolean, YAML 1.2 a string.

vectors.name: leading-zero
vectors.about: Eight in YAML 1.1, ten in YAML 1.2.

vectors.name: exponent
vectors.about: A string in YAML 1.1, a number in YAML 1.2.

vectors.name: sexagesimal
vectors.about: Ninety in YAML 1.1.

vectors.name: date
vectors.about: A date in YAML 1.1, a string in YAML 1.2.

vectors.name: keep-chomping
vectors.about: Only |, >, |- and >-.

vectors.name: more-indented-line-in-folded
vectors.about: Folding rules for more-indented lines differ in subtle ways: use | instead.

vectors.name: unknown-escape
vectors.about: Only \\ \" \/ \n \t.

vectors.name: uneven-indent
vectors.about: Siblings share one indentation.

vectors.name: json-manifest
vectors.about: The specification says a manifest may be JSON: a document whose first character is { is one JSON object, over as many lines as it likes.

vectors.name: json-nested-and-typed
vectors.about: JSON's true, false and null, nesting, and string escapes.

vectors.name: json-after-a-comment-and-marker
vectors.about: Comments and one leading --- may come before the object, and comments after it.

vectors.name: json-keys-need-not-be-plain-words
vectors.about: In a JSON object any string is a key, and a quoted yes or 010 is a string.

vectors.name: flow-mapping-at-the-top
vectors.about: A one-line flow mapping in the subset's own style is a document too.

vectors.name: json-exponent
vectors.about: YAML 1.1 readers take 1e3 for a string.

vectors.name: json-tab
vectors.about: A tab between tokens is refused, as in indentation.

vectors.name: flow-mapping-at-the-top-over-two-lines
vectors.about: The subset's own flow mapping stays on one line; over lines it must be JSON.

vectors.name: flow-sequence-at-the-top
vectors.about: A document is a mapping or a block list.

vectors.name: json-nested-too-deeply
vectors.about: Nothing nested more than 64 deep: 65 lists inside the object.

vectors.name: json-surrogate-escape
vectors.about: A \ud800 to \udfff escape, alone or as a pair, is refused: a YAML reader takes each half for a character.

vectors.name: json-escaped-backslash-before-u
vectors.about: Two backslashes and then ud800 is a backslash and plain letters.
